behavior: Anchor this defense at the first threatened mining hall. Start fighting when the arrived force has 1.25 times the local enemy strength or the hall/workers are under attack; the remaining original defenders continue to that anchor and join on actual arrival. The general keeps commanding other units. Only accepted strategic orders change assignment; local combat and recovery keep it.

specification.script_declares_redirects: local | strategic; undeclared custom scripts default to strategic; every room-AI tactic must explicitly declare its semantics

scripted_regression.local_engagement_definition: A tracked defender actually damages an enemy while within 650 of the defended hall.
tests_added: sufficient arrived group starts fighting with reinforcements still absent
hall damage immediately starts fighting with no arrived force
worker damage immediately starts fighting with no arrived force
general still commands troops outside the rally assignment
new local, strategic and undeclared script names transfer ownership according to metadata alone
all three room-AI families explicitly declare every tactic

mac1.renderer: native client world renderer; both complete AI stacks; normal planner phases and three-tick command delay
mac1.sampling: every tick; key frames every 20 game seconds, plus exact first-fight and last-reinforcement frames
mac1.final_source_equivalence: Final four script declarations and regression additions produce byte-identical complete delivered-command streams to these mac1 replays; hashes and source IDs in raw evidence.

validation.supplemental_case: All 11 rally behavior/declaration cases and real mountedField ownership-conflict coverage are included in the suite.

limits: This unedited archer snapshot damages neither hall in either replay, so the non-increasing damage assertion is 0 vs 0. Separate derived cases in the same captured terrain verify immediate response to hall and worker damage. Every original defender must physically reach the anchor once; arrived fighters can keep fighting while later reinforcements arrive. The pursuit leash and fixed harassment squad remain separate following changes. general.ts is unchanged.
